proposal.title: Launch all four Academy courses at the June 16 Academy launch
proposal.reason: Set the four named Academy course products’ launch_event_id to event.academy_launch (16 June 1978). Retain their campaign, course content, providers and other terms. The June 5 platform announcement remains distinct from these courses’ own launch.

before.name: Aurelia Fundamentals
before.description: Aurelia Fundamentals: two days of hands-on learning before purchase, including business-computer capabilities, configuration selection, common editing, Business Tools and introductory Abacus. Purchasing advice carries no obligation to buy.

specification.description: The course provides this amount of instruction.
Learn what a business computer can do and choose an appropriate configuration.
Practise common editing, Business Tools and introductory Abacus workflows.
specification.value: Common editing, Business Tools and introductory Abacus

specification.description: Receive purchasing advice without an obligation to buy.
The course can be delivered at either of these locations.
specification.value: Logix Computer Academy facility or customer’s office
